label: models/fw_pipejunction.mdl: two pipes meeting at a flanged elbow, bolted

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_hgun.mdl, models/w_suit.mdl, models/w_oxygen.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked B, B, D, D where the asset was C, A, A, C: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The outline matches the brief's words in all ten views: a vertical pipe rising from a flanged elbow that turns 90 degrees into a horizontal pipe. Both pipes are the same width and the bend reads cleanly in LEFT, RIGHT and FRONT-LEFT.

M2.reason: The brief gives no size for the pipe junction (sizeAsked null, sizeOff null), so there is no size to be out by. The measured 49.5 x 18.1 x 56 units is a plausible pipe-and-elbow scale, and the pipe diameter reads at about 18 units.

M3.reason: The named parts are all there: two pipes, a flanged elbow, and bolts. The bolts show as small studs around the elbow flange (FRONT, BACK, TOP, BELOW) and the vertical pipe's flange (LEFT, RIGHT). The horizontal pipe has its own flange at the elbow joint. The base tabs and brackets are not named by the brief. The number of sides on the round parts cannot be checked, since no Half-Life pipe is in the line-up.

M4.reason: The materials fit the brief's rusted steel: blue-grey pipes with orange-brown rust, and a darker brown rust elbow and flanges. The colours agree across all views and sit in Half-Life's palette.

M5.reason: Rust streaks, flange highlights and bolt studs are present. The elbow has a slightly blocky rust patch in FRONT and FRONT-LEFT, but it adds nothing wrong at game size.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the rule. In the line-up test, judges picked B, B, D and D, never the asset (C). It passed as one of the game's.

M7.reason: The pipe stands upright on a flat base tab at its bottom, shown in BELOW and RIGHT. The flanged elbow sits at the base with the horizontal pipe off to the side. The brief sets no front, and the views read as a standing fitting.

M8.reason: SMAK's checks are clean and the triangle count (412) is under twice Half-Life's median (476) and under the most Valve spends on its kind (439). But the elbow's bowl is visibly hollow from outside: the dark recessed mouth in FRONT, FRONT-LEFT and BELOW looks open to a player. The pipe ends are capped (TOP, BACK), so the fault is confined to the elbow.
